source_method_limits.Cdelta_or_acceptance: actual Cdelta=null; oblique/eccentric interaction, splitting, net section and full group/wrench capacity remain unresolved; structural acceptance/fabrication/climbing releases remain false.
source_method_limits.Cg: Only an unadopted gross-EA two-bolt row comparator is evaluated for each current rear pair using the pure frozen cg_si formula. Closed Cg=1 is accepted numerically within tolerance; actual Cg and complete group capacity remain null.
source_method_limits.TR12: Existing source-bound adapter produces only conditional two-member, one-shear-plane lateral translation references; wood Fe=G0.50 and generic TR12 Fyb=45 ksi remain unadopted. Three-or-more media and other unsupported topologies keep capacity null.
source_method_limits.custom_packers: Packer dimensions/material remain provisional and unaccepted; this adapter does not qualify packer fit/contact or side-rail bearing.
source_method_limits.edge: Force signs are projected at each fresh receiver action's own source reference point against the current finished-profile boundary normal. Per-action normal force is not an NDS loaded/unloaded classification, Cdelta, splitting check, or wrench capacity.
source_method_limits.front_back: Current W-min is treated as front and W-max as rear per the owner correction. The withdrawn V1 wrong-sign prediction and its numeric margins are not used.
source_method_limits.full_wrench: Every selected signed shear-plane six-wrench and each wood receiver force/free-couple action remain source-bound in case_axis_signed_wrench_rows. No force averaging, axis-end moment substitution, or scalar P/Z whole-connection pass.
source_method_limits.geometry: End/edge distances use the center of each bound wood-bearing interval for the geometric census; signed force directions use the saved action point. Axis-origin coordinates are not treated as the bearing centroid.
source_method_limits.hardware_inventory: The bank-bound hardware manifest selects current side/cleat target IDs and verifies companion geometry/media joins. Its physical interval evidence is not substituted for the authenticated per-case shaft cuts or signed receiver actions, and it supplies no force/capacity values.

custom_packers.construction_hypothesis: Solid dry DF-L No.2 custom cut; not a built-up or laminated stock approval.
